layers.source: Source: EC JRC/Google — Global Surface Water v1.3 1984–2020 (Pekel et al. 2016) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
layers.method: occurrence mosaic of 0E_40Nv1_3_2020 → scene grid (area average); pixel = round(occurrence % × 2.55), 0 = never water or no data
layers.uncertainty: Landsat 30 m monthly history; occurrence is a long-term frequency, not the 2026 state; small/narrow water is under-detected
layers.label: Surface-water occurrence 1984–2020 (JRC GSW)

layers.source: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200 (Zanaga et al. 2022), © ESA WorldCover project / contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021), via Microsoft Planetary Computer
layers.method: map mosaic of ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N36E009, ESA_WorldCover_10m_2021_v200_N36E006 → scene grid (MODE). Palette PNG: pixel value = class code (10 tree, 20 shrub, 30 grass, 40 cropland, 50 built-up, 60 bare, 80 water, 90 wetland); 0 = no data (transparent); official WorldCover colours
layers.uncertainty: Global map, ~77% overall accuracy (v200 validation); cropland/grassland confusion common in semi-arid Tunisia; state of 2021
layers.label: Land cover 2021 (ESA WorldCover)

layers.source: NASA LGRIP30 v001 (LP DAAC, 2015) + ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A (Jul–Aug 2026) + ESA WorldCover 2021
layers.method: irrigated = WorldCover cropland with Jul–Aug 2026 median NDVI > 0.3 (rainfed cereals are harvested by June); compared with LGRIP30 irrigated class; polygons ≥ 2 ha
layers.uncertainty: 90% of these fields lie inside LGRIP30's irrigated class; LGRIP30 itself marks 84% of cropland irrigated (over-inclusive here). Orchards also stay green; fields left dry in summer 2026 are missed; not the official CRDA perimeter boundaries
layers.label: Irrigated cropland, summer 2026 (Mellègue–Medjerda valley)

layers.source: GEM-15 (experimental) DTM, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0 (gaps: NASADEM); HydroRIVERS v1.0; OpenStreetMap; pysheds 0.5
layers.method: D8 steepest descent on GEM-15 (experimental) bare-earth DTM 15 m block-averaged to 30 m, HydroRIVERS main stem burned −2 m, depressions filled (priority-flood + ε); 101 km, simplified 30 m
layers.uncertainty: 30 m terrain; no surveyed channel geometry; the channel is burned along HydroRIVERS (≈ 500 m source resolution), so the path is a routing line, not a surveyed thalweg
layers.label: Flow path: dam → Sidi Salem

layers.source: GEM-15 (experimental) DTM, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0 (gaps: NASADEM); HydroRIVERS v1.0; OpenStreetMap; pysheds 0.5
layers.method: ≤ 5 km from the flow path, reservoirs excluded (GEM-15 (experimental) bare-earth DTM 15 m block-averaged to 30 m)
layers.uncertainty: 30 m terrain; no surveyed channel geometry; the channel is burned along HydroRIVERS (≈ 500 m source resolution), so the path is a routing line, not a surveyed thalweg
layers.label: HAND corridor

layers.source: GEM-15 (experimental) DTM, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0 (gaps: NASADEM); HydroRIVERS v1.0; OpenStreetMap; pysheds 0.5
layers.method: DEM: GEM-15 (experimental) bare-earth DTM 15 m block-averaged to 30 m. HAND = height above the main-stem flow-path cell each cell drains to (pysheds D8, HydroRIVERS channel burned −2 m). Corridor ≤ 5 km from the path, dam → Sidi Salem (101 km; Reach 1 dam → Medjerda confluence 45 km), reservoirs excluded. V(h) = Σ(h − HAND)·900 m² over HAND < h. Exposure: ESA WorldCover 2021 (cropland 40, built-up 50), WorldPop 2020 constrained (population), OSM (roads all classes incl. tracks, building centroids, place=village|town|hamlet within 200 m of wet cells). Web grid: area-averaged from 30 m; uint16 = HAND in cm, 65535 = outside the corridor.
layers.uncertainty: Static 'bathtub': the whole volume is spread at one height along the entire valley at once; it ignores timing, attenuation and channel capacity, so it underestimates depth near the dam during the peak and overstates simultaneous extent downstream. HAND is ≈ 0 inside depression-filled channel reaches (19 km² are already 'wet' at h = 0.25 m): storage below the fill level is not counted, so small volumes map to a wide, shallow footprint. 30 m terrain with no channel bathymetry (±5–10 m vertical in places); OSM buildings and roads are incomplete; WorldPop is itself a model. Exposure screening only, not a forecast.
layers.label: Height above the river (HAND)
